title: Bug: shadowing confusion
starterCode:
var x = 1
function test() {
  console.log(x)  // Should be 1, not undefined
  var x = 2
}
test()
return 1
solution:
var x = 1
function test() {
  console.log(x)
  var x = 2
}
test()
return 1
hints: var x = 2 declaration hoists, so x is undefined in the function
